items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I never knew that. One of the way I left out was Pallet. His name was Henry James.

ctx.x: Yeah. Joe Gabriel, he was the violin player. And Nettie James, that was the guitar player. The fellow that played bass, he called him bourgeois.
What did you say? You used to call those James? What's his nickname? Dodoos. Dodoos?
Yeah. How did you get that name out of it? I don't know, that's what we used to call it. I never knew that. One of the way I left out was Pallet. His name was Henry James.
